title: Virginia overlay
description: Adds Virginia's curbside voting checks (Va. Code § 24.2-649) to the federal base, for voters age 65 or older and voters with a disability who vote from their vehicle, and cites Va. Code § 24.2-310 for polling place accessibility.

sources.title: Code of Virginia § 24.2-310 — Requirements for polling places
Code of Virginia § 24.2-649 — Assistance for certain voters; curbside voting

kit.name: “Curbside voting” sign with instructions
kit.description: Tells voters how to call an officer of election: doorbell, phone number, or honk.

section.title: Curbside voting
section.summary: Virginia voters age 65 or older and voters with a disability may vote from their vehicle. Check the curbside location as it will be set up.

items.prompt: Is there a designated curbside voting spot close to the entrance where a vehicle can pull over safely?

fix.summary: Reserve a space next to the entrance with cones and a curbside voting sign.

public.label: Curbside voting
public.pass: Curbside voting is available next to the entrance.
public.fixed: Curbside voting will be set up next to the entrance on election day.

items.prompt: Is there a sign at the curbside spot explaining how to request curbside voting?

fix.summary: Post a curbside voting sign with the call instructions.

items.prompt: Can a voter in a vehicle alert an officer of election without leaving the car (doorbell, buzzer or posted phone number)?

fix.summary: Mount a wireless doorbell button at the curbside spot with the chime at the check-in table.

items.prompt: Is an officer of election assigned to watch for curbside voters throughout the day?

fix.summary: Add a curbside duty to the officer-of-election assignments, with a relief schedule.
